description: 32 s first-person clip in a grassy Minetest Game landscape (hills, mountains, blue sky): the player walks up to a small yard and stands still while two square letter boards float side by side and a penguin walks a loop in front of them carrying a small letter board above its head, then walks around the left board to look at the boards from behind.
reproduces: https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/issues/15105 (an upright_sprite entity using spritediv {1,4} with set_sprite stays on its first frame next to an identical camera-facing sprite that animates), extended with four further sprite-entity defects injected for this task: camera-facing sprites drawn mirrored, the back face of upright sprites drawn mirrored, select_x_by_camera picking the front/back (or left/right) view of a turned subject the wrong way round, and sprite animations not advancing while the entity is attached to another object.
scenario: Minetest Game 5.8.0, v7 mapgen, fixed seed 135797531, time frozen at noon. A world mod (not shipped) flattens a round grass yard and spawns: an animated upright_sprite board (front texture A-D strip, back texture E-F-G-K strip, spritediv {1,4}, set_sprite 4 frames x 1.0 s, turned 180 degrees so its front faces the camera) on the left; an animated camera-facing sprite board with the same A-D strip on the right; a penguin (camera-facing sprite, 6-column x 2-row sheet, select_x_by_camera, automatic_face_movement_dir) walking a 5 x 2 node rectangle at 1 node/s (right, towards the camera, left, away); and a small animated camera-facing A-D board attached above the penguin's head. The camera walks in (0-3 s), holds on the yard (3-15 s), walks round the left board (15-23 s) and holds behind the boards (23-32 s). Recorded headlessly (Xvfb, Mesa llvmpipe, ffmpeg x11grab, 1280x720 at 30 fps) from the task image's own build with all five defects present.
